$comment: Canonical config schema. Run task gen to update the embedded copy.
title: padmate configuration
description: Profile selection, device filtering and global mapping defaults. Strict JSON.

enabled.description: Enable automatic profile selection; defaults to true. Manual pause is independent.

onUnmatched.description: Ignored since ADR-0053: applications no rule binds use the fixed default profile. Accepted so that older files load; do not write it.

releaseOnSwitch.description: Release on foreground changes. Profile changes always release.

restoreLayerState.description: Restore persistent layers for each device and profile; defaults to true.

defaultProfile.description: Ignored since ADR-0053: the fixed default profile has the library ID "default". Accepted so that older files load; do not write it.

ignore.description: Ignored since ADR-0053: every application either has a rule or uses the fixed default profile. Accepted so that older files load; do not write it.

rules.description: The first enabled rule that matches the foreground application and names a profile selects it; applications no rule binds use the fixed default profile "default".

devices.description: Device settings indexed by canonical DeviceKey.

timing.description: Defaults beneath profile and binding timing overrides.

feedback.description: The controller feedback switches (ADR-0067): they apply to every profile and every controller, and take effect at once.

safety.description: Emergency button combinations by controller family.

rule.title: Automatic profile rule
rule.description: Case-insensitive exe name or absolute path match.

exe.description: Executable name or absolute Windows path.

profile.description: Library ID. null, which disabled mapping before ADR-0053, is accepted so that older files load; such a rule is ignored. Do not write null.

enabled.description: Whether this rule participates; defaults to true.

device.description: Rules apply to every device. Device-specific rules are not planned yet (Backlog PRO-15).

device.title: Device settings
device.description: Settings of one controller: exclude it from mapping without hiding its input, calibrate its sticks, or give SDL a mapping for it.

mapping.description: SDL gamepad mapping string for this controller (IN-18, ADR-0072): it makes SDL read a joystick it does not know as a gamepad, or reads a known gamepad differently. Form: the controller's GUID, the name field *, the bindings such as a:b0 and platform:Windows. SDL applies a mapping by GUID, so every device key with the same GUID carries the same string; the mapping wizard and devices.setMapping write them together.

calibration.description: Stick calibration of this controller. It overrides the deadzone and saturation of the profile in use; a member that is left out keeps the profile's value.

calibration.title: Stick calibration
calibration.description: Per-controller deadzone and outer edge of each stick (IN-14).

stickCalibration.title: Calibration of one stick
stickCalibration.description: Overrides analog.ls or analog.rs of the profile in use, for this controller only. When both members are given, saturation must be greater than deadzone.

deadzone.description: Radial deadzone as a fraction of travel, 0 to 1.

saturation.description: Outer edge as a fraction of travel, 0 to 1: the radius at which the stick counts as fully pushed. A smaller value reaches full depth sooner.

eventGapMs.description: Minimum gap between consecutive keyboard events padmate injects; 0 sends a chord in one SendInput call.

sendToOwnWindow.description: Explicitly allow keyboard output to verified padmate UI windows; defaults to false. Changes take effect immediately.

feedback.title: Feedback switches
feedback.description: Each switch is on unless it is false; the UI writes false for a switch that is off and leaves the member out when it is on.

rumble.description: Whether rumble is enabled: the pulses of layer changes and pause, the haptics of bindings and knob ticks, the low-battery buzz, and rumble from scripts.

led.description: Whether the lights follow padmate: layer colors and the pause color on RGB LEDs, the mode on the player lights, the low-battery flash, and lights from scripts.

pause.description: Whether pausing and resuming the mapping is shown on the controller: the pulse, and the pause color. It works through rumble and led: with either off, that part is not shown either.

lowBattery.description: Whether a low battery of a controller is announced: the controller buzzes and blinks, and padmate shows a notice in the tray and on the overlay. It works through rumble and led for the controller's own part.

panic.description: Overrides by device family. Omitted families use their built-in combination.

combo.title: Emergency combination
combo.description: Hold all listed physical buttons to toggle pause.

buttons.description: Canonical physical SDL button names; at least two, so that one button held a little long never pauses.

holdMs.description: Required continuous hold duration in milliseconds; at least 500.
